userStories.title: Replace hardcoded BTC change with live CoinGecko price check
userStories.description:
Current state: run_pipeline.py at businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/scripts/run_pipeline.py has btc_change_4h = 0.5 hardcoded. The macro kill switch in signal_filter.py checks btc_change_4h < -3.0 but it never fires because the value is always +0.5.

What to build:
1. Add get_btc_4h_change() function to run_pipeline.py (or a new utils module):
   - Call CoinGecko free API: GET https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/bitcoin/market_chart?vs_currency=usd&days=1
   - This returns hourly price points for the last 24h (no API key needed)
   - Extract the price from ~4 hours ago and the current price
   - Calculate: btc_change_4h = ((current - price_4h_ago) / price_4h_ago) * 100
   - Return the float (negative if BTC dropped)
   - On error: return 0.0 (neutral — don't kill switch on API failure)
   - Add a 10-second timeout to prevent pipeline stall

2. In main(), replace:
     btc_change_4h = 0.5
   with:
     btc_change_4h = get_btc_4h_change()
     print(f'[PIPELINE] BTC 4h change: {btc_change_4h:+.1f}%')

Constraints:
- Do NOT modify signal_filter.py or any other script
- CoinGecko free tier: 10-30 calls/min — one call per 30-min pipeline run is well within limits
- No API key needed — CoinGecko free tier is sufficient
- Function must handle rate limiting (429) gracefully — return 0.0 on any error
